title: Fancy Default
description: A performance and visual enhancement built for SMPs
body:
This light Vanilla modpack contains a variety of mods and resource packs to enhance Vanilla Minecraft.



These include: 

Perfomance Enhancements

Audio and Visual Enhancements

UI Enhancements

Various Vanilla Style Tweaks 

3D Textures and Physics

Entity Animations



Most mods are Client-Side, and can be configured to your liking. 

No game-altering mods are in this pack. This is still Vanilla Minecraft, it just looks, sounds, and feels nicer.



Designed for use on SMP servers. (Can be used in any Vanilla server, and even realms.)

This modpack will provide the peak SMP experience.

Thank you to the creators of all the mods and resource packs included. They do fantastic work, check them out.
